usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
usdRate.note: The US dollar is the official currency.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Asian Development Bank, Asian Development Outlook September 2026 (Marshall Islands economy page)
inflation_cpi.note: ADB Asian Development Outlook (Sep 2026) estimate for calendar 2026, not a measured CPI reading (ADB forecasts 4.7% for 2027); the statistics office (EPPSO) has published no recent CPI report, so this published estimate is used.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ADB 2027 forecast 4.7%; US-dollar economy with US inflation near 2-3%
inflation_projection.note: Prices follow US and import costs and the IMF expects inflation to stay above its historical average for a while, so we plan with 3%.

policy_rate.note: The Marshall Islands has no central bank and uses the US dollar, so there is no national policy rate.

savings_account_rate.note: No published savings account rates of banks in the Marshall Islands found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month time deposit rates found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year time deposit rates found.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no value for the Marshall Islands; no average deposit rate published.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The government issues no treasury bills.

tbond_5y_rate.note: The government issues no domestic bonds.

tbond_10y_rate.note: The government issues no domestic bonds.

tax_bank_interest.note: Could not confirm how bank interest is taxed for residents (the income tax is mainly a wages and salary tax); no official tax page reached.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No national deposit insurance scheme found; a US bank branch operating in the RMI may carry US FDIC cover, but we could not confirm it.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card rate cap or typical rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollars; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09%
equity_return_low.note: No local stock market; low case for a global index fund in dollars over a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollars; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09%
equity_return_base.note: No local stock market, so the base is a global index in dollars at about 3 points over US bills, within the 4-point limit.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollars
equity_return_high.note: High case with a full equity premium.

gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade; the US dollar is the local currency.

gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% with no currency effect.

gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Local bank deposits (no published rates); US Treasury bills
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case for local savings and time deposits. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Local bank deposits (no published rates); US Treasury bills
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case below the US bill rate because local deposits pay less and US bills need a foreign broker. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near US Treasury bill yields. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No insurance regulator statistics on life claim settlement found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No locally published term life premium rates found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical hospital stay cost found; most care is public and serious cases are referred abroad.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)
oop_health_share.note: About 1.1%: public and donor funding cover almost all health spending. Latest World Bank (WHO GHED) value is for 2023, older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation projection; very low out-of-pocket share (World Bank)
goal_inflation_health.note: Households pay little directly, so we plan 1 point above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI published; we plan 1 point above general inflation for fees and study abroad.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)
life_expectancy.note: Men 65.0, women 69.5 (2024, older than 2025); UN WPP via georank gives 67.3 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source for UN WPP.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank WDI, age dependency ratio, old (SP.POP.DPND.OL)
support_ratio.note: 100 / 7.96 old-age dependency ratio (2025); populationpyramid.net has no Marshall Islands pages, so no 2040 or 2065 projection could be read.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Marshall Islands Social Security Administration (MISSA), Retirement benefits
retirement_age_default.note: Normal retirement age 63 with at least 12 quarters of coverage (P.L. 2021-36 capped the normal retirement age at 63); early and deferred retirement were abolished in March 2017. MISSA also lists a Bill No. 45 on changing the retirement age whose content could not be read.

retirement_age_government.note: Could not find the public service retirement age.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case for local deposits. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Local bank deposits; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the US bill rate, the only verifiable safe dollar rate. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

retirement_return_high.note: High case near US bill yields. Safe USD rates: no published local deposit rates found; the RMI has no central bank or government securities and uses the US dollar; US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026), reachable only through foreign brokers.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of dollar deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of dollar deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Half global equity at 7% and half safe assets near 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of dollar deposits and a global equity index

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Non-contributory Social Support Scheme pension of $100 a month for citizens aged 60+ who receive no MISSA or other retirement pension, paid since October 2025 as a three-year pilot, so it may change or end after FY2028.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 60+, RMI citizenship, one year's residence; no income test is described, but anyone receiving a MISSA or other retirement pension is excluded. Three-year pilot from October 2025.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Marshall Islands Social Security Administration (MISSA), Retirement and General Provisions
public_pension_scheme.note: Contributory MISSA retirement pension from 63 (fully insured: 12 to 38 quarters of coverage); monthly benefit = 1/12 of (2% of indexed covered earnings + a social element of 14.5% of the first $11,000 and 0.7% of cumulative earnings from $11,000 to $44,000), minimum $128.99, with cuts above $299.99 since 2017. No cost-of-living adjustment is described, so inflationLinked is false; contribution rates and tax treatment were not stated.

savings_account.note: Offered by the banks operating in the RMI; rates not published.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail bond.

tbill_91d.note: The government issues no treasury bills.

tbond_5y.note: The government issues no domestic bonds.

tbond_10y.note: The government issues no domestic bonds.

equity_fund.note: No local stock market or funds; residents can only invest in US-listed index funds through foreign brokers.

gold.note: No local gold dealers; gold must be bought from abroad.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Human Services (MOHHS)

statistics.name: Economic Policy, Planning and Statistics Office (EPPSO)
